thread: 2026-11-06: Pace Digitek Ltd concall confirmed expanding BESS manufacturing capacity to 5 GWh, targeting 10 GWh by Q4 FY27.
2026-11-13: SPML Infra Ltd investor deck detailed scaling BESS capacity from 2.5 GWh to 5 GWh by FY28 with ~Rs 238 crore capex.
2026-11-16: Waaree Energies Ltd commissioned a 5.15 GWh battery pack manufacturing line and later bagged over Rs 100 crore NTPC storage order.
2026-11-17: Power Grid Corporation of India Ltd won 100 MW/400 MWh BESS AP tender, backed by government's Rs 1.86 lakh crore Green Energy Corridor Phase-III outlay.
2026-11-27: Larsen & Toubro Ltd secured a major Rs 3,000 crore order for a 300 MW/900 MWh battery storage project at Khavda, Gujarat.
2026-11-28.cooking: Policy mandates and green corridor approvals are turning energy storage into a major capital deployment vector for Indian power infrastructure. Early order winners and battery pack integrators will see significant multi-year revenue visibility and margin expansion as execution ramps up.
2026-11-28.confirm: Financial closure and execution timelines for Khavda and Andhra Pradesh BESS projects in Q4 FY27.
2026-11-28.risk: Battery cell input cost spikes or execution delays in power purchase agreements (PPAs) by state DISCOMs.
2026-11-28.stage: early - National BESS tenders and 5 GWh+ factory expansions are being awarded/built, but revenue execution will not hit earnings until H2 FY27 and FY28.
cos: Power Grid Corporation of India Ltd

2026-11-28.name: Premium Hospitality Industry
2026-11-28.head: Strong H2 wedding and MICE demand combined with aggressive asset-light and owned expansion drive multi-year re-rating.
thread: 2026-10-28: Indian Hotels Company Ltd Q2 call highlighted 18th consecutive record quarter, upgraded full-year guidance on strong domestic demand and H2 wedding calendar.
2026-11-20: Apeejay Surrendra Park Hotels Ltd signed 100-room luxury hotel MoU in Visakhapatnam and acquired controlling stake in Zillion Hotels, Juhu.
2026-11-22: Chalet Hotels Ltd announced ₹3,500 crore capex plan over 3 years to scale portfolio to 5,500+ keys and launched proprietary "Athiva" brand.
2026-11-27: Apeejay Surrendra Park Hotels Ltd secured a 60-year concession from Meghalaya government to develop and operate a 120-room 5-star hotel in Shillong.
2026-11-28.cooking: High H2 occupancy (~93-94%) driven by domestic travel and corporate events is sustaining strong RevPAR growth across major chains. Multi-brand key additions provide clear cash flow visibility into FY28.
2026-11-28.confirm: Q3 FY27 operational metrics (occupancy and ARR numbers) during the peak winter travel season.
2026-11-28.risk: Geopolitical travel disruptions or macro consumer discretionary spending slowdown.
2026-11-28.stage: building - Capacity additions and brand licensing are announced, while H2 peak season pricing power and margin gains are yet to fully reflect in numbers.

2026-11-28.name: Diamond Power Infrastructure Ltd
2026-11-28.head: Diversifies beyond single-client reliance into data center cables alongside Rs 1,200+ crore HVDC conductor wins.
thread: 2026-11-07: Concall reported record quarterly revenue crossing Rs 1,000 crore and successful exit from NCLT.
2026-11-19: Secured massive Rs 707 crore conductor order from Adani Energy Solutions.
2026-11-24: Announced strategic diversification into data centre cable business, reducing single-group client reliance.
2026-11-25: Secured additional Rs 488.18 crore AL-59 conductor order from Adani Energy Solutions for HVDC project.
2026-11-28.cooking: Transmission infrastructure spends in HVDC corridors combined with entry into high-margin data center cable supply significantly expand the addressable market. Top-line growth and balance sheet normalization post-NCLT pave the way for sustained valuation re-rating.
2026-11-28.confirm: Dispatch schedules and execution start for the AL-59 conductor orders in H2 FY27.
2026-11-28.risk: Raw material price volatility in aluminum and copper or delay in transmission project schedules.
2026-11-28.stage: early - HVDC conductor orders worth over Rs 1,200 crore and data center client entry are signed, but earnings will recognize revenue across FY27-28.

2026-11-28.name: Premier Explosives Ltd
2026-11-28.head: Katepally RDX/HMX plant commercialization aligns with Rs 311 crore defence export win and strategic change in control.
thread: 2026-11-12: Investor deck highlighted acquisition of 41.33% promoter stake by Apollo Micro Systems for ~Rs 1,550 crore.
2026-11-17: Q2 concall confirmed water trials started at Katepally RDX/HMX plant, targeting commercial production by mid-to-end December 2026.
2026-11-21: Won $33.6 million (Rs 311 crore) international defence export order for defence explosives with a 12-month delivery window.
2026-11-28.cooking: Commissioning of high-margin RDX/HMX capacity combined with Apollo Micro Systems' controlling ownership creates immediate cross-selling defence synergies. Delivery of the large export order will drive a sharp uptick in operating margins starting Q4 FY27.
2026-11-28.confirm: Declaration of commercial production at the Katepally facility in December 2026.
2026-11-28.risk: Delays in board reconstitution/open offer closure or supply chain bottlenecks for key chemical inputs.
2026-11-28.stage: building - Price down -24% vs Nifty in a month; export order won and plant trials underway, with commercial revenues kicking in from Q4 FY27.

2026-11-28.name: Dhoot Transmission Ltd
2026-11-28.head: Balance sheet turns net cash post debt repayment while entering ADAS JV and building 5 new manufacturing plants.
thread: 2026-11-04: Formed 67:33 JV with Ride Vision for 2W/CV ADAS localization and announced plant expansions in Hosur, Jhajjar, Pune, and Chennai.
2026-11-10: Q2 concall confirmed full repayment of IPO debt (Rs 900 cr net cash), 108% surge in EV revenues, and 5 plant additions over 12 months.
2026-11-25: Management reiterated expecting over 40% growth this year driven by commercial vehicle electrification and EV business expansion.
2026-11-28.cooking: Rapid top-line growth (>60% YoY in Q2) combined with high-margin EV wiring harness and ADAS penetration transforms the return profile. A fully de-leveraged balance sheet provides ample headroom for funding aggressive expansion without equity dilution.
2026-11-28.confirm: Commercial launch updates on RideVision ADAS products expected in Q3 FY27 concall.
2026-11-28.risk: Broad commercial vehicle volume slowdown or delays in OEM EV model rollouts.
2026-11-28.stage: early - Net cash position of Rs 900 crore and >40% growth guidance achieved, while 5 new plants and ADAS tech rollout commence in FY27.

2026-11-28.name: Welspun Corp Ltd
2026-11-28.head: All-time high order book of Rs 50,000 crore backed by global line pipe wins and Rs 3,200 crore textile expansion.
thread: 2026-11-23: Announced ~Rs 3,200 crore capex plan for terry towel capacity expansion and backward integration.
2026-11-26: Secured global pipe and line contracts worth Rs 2,264 crore across key energy markets.
2026-11-27: Confirmed consolidated order book crossed all-time high of Rs 50,000 crore providing 5-year revenue visibility.
2026-11-28.cooking: A record pipeline order book de-risks multi-year earnings, while massive backward integration in home textiles elevates blended operating margins. The recent stock price correction provides asymmetric upside as order execution ramps up.
2026-11-28.confirm: Commencement of dispatch schedules for the newly bagged Rs 2,264 crore export contracts.
2026-11-28.risk: Delays in global oil & gas pipeline project execution or sustained high steel plate input costs.
2026-11-28.stage: building - Price down -18% vs Nifty in a month; order book provides 5-year visibility, but top-line execution will ramp up over H2 FY27 and FY28.

2026-11-28.name: Omnitech Engineering Ltd
2026-11-28.head: Strategic entry into defence assemblies with BrahMos order alongside Rajkot facility expansion to Rs 1,200 cr revenue capacity.
thread: 2026-11-12: Q2 concall detailed Chhapara (Rajkot) facility expansion to increase peak revenue potential to Rs 1,100–1,200 crore in 10-11 months.
2026-11-20: Read-across from Cummins India call highlighted strong data center power gen demand; Omnitech secured Rs 387 crore defence commercial orders.
2026-11-27: Won development order from BrahMos Aerospace for precision missile assemblies.
2026-11-28.cooking: Diversification from industrial machinery into high-margin defence assemblies and data center power components structurally lifts margin expectations. The stock's recent severe sell-off creates an opportunity ahead of massive capacity commissioning in late FY27.
2026-11-28.confirm: Prototype approval and follow-on serial production order from BrahMos Aerospace.
2026-11-28.risk: Execution delays at the Chhapara facility or longer qualification cycles for defence orders.
2026-11-28.stage: building - Price down -33% vs Nifty in a month; defence development orders signed, but revenue scale-up depends on plant commissioning in 10 months.

2026-11-28.name: KNR Constructions Ltd
2026-11-28.head: Fully monetizes HAM assets unlocking capital to fund ~Rs 1,000 cr mining capex and execution of Rs 1,396 cr HMDA project.
thread: 2026-11-13: Deck confirmed completion of all four HAM asset transfers to Indus Infra Trust and LOA for Rs 1,396 crore HMDA elevated corridor.
2026-11-20: Q2 concall detailed H1 capex of ~Rs 500 crore each for Kusmunda and Banhardih mining projects, targeting Rs 400 crore mining revenue by FY28.
2026-11-20: Confirmed transfer of final two HAM assets (Guruvayur in Sept, Ramanattukara in Oct) to Indus Infra Trust and target Rs 4,000-5,000 cr H2 order inflows.
2026-11-28.cooking: Unlocking capital from monetized HAM assets strengthens cash reserves, allowing KNR to aggressively scale high-margin contract mining and urban infrastructure. With HAM appointed dates due in December 2026, execution will accelerate rapidly in H2 FY27.
2026-11-28.confirm: Declaration of appointed date for HMDA elevated corridor in December 2026.
2026-11-28.risk: Slower-than-expected highway project awards by NHAI or payment delays from state agencies.
2026-11-28.stage: building - Stock down -10% vs Nifty in a month; HAM monetization complete and HMDA LOA received, while H2 execution ramp-up is yet to show in numbers.

2026-11-28.name: Gulshan Polyols Ltd
2026-11-28.head: Multi-pronged expansion in ethanol, sorbitol, and green hydrogen backed by Rs 1,300 crore OMC order book.
thread: 2026-11-12: Announced 6 MW green hydrogen BOO contract worth Rs 300 crore and received Rs 1,305 crore OMC ethanol allocation.
2026-11-17: Q2 concall confirmed 19.7 crore liters ethanol allocation (Rs 1,300 crore order book + Rs 300 crore byproducts) with flexible feedstock mix (maize/rice).
2026-11-17: Detailed Rs 100-120 crore capex to expand sorbitol (+30,000 MTPA) and MDP/NDC (6x to 30,000 MTPA) at Muzaffarnagar by May 2027.
2026-11-28.cooking: OMC ethanol allocation guarantees top-line execution, while specialty chemical expansions (sorbitol/MDP) and green hydrogen captive reduction will drive substantial margin expansion from FY28.
2026-11-28.confirm: Commissioning of expanded sorbitol/MDP lines at Muzaffarnagar in mid-2027.
2026-11-28.risk: Persistent high maize input prices eroding distillery margins.
2026-11-28.stage: early - Stock down -8% vs Nifty in a month; 19.7 cr liter ethanol allocation secured and green hydrogen BOO signed, with full earnings contribution in FY28.

2026-11-28.name: Hospital Expansion & M&A Supercycle
2026-11-28.head: Aggressive bed capacity expansion and strategic regional M&A drive healthcare sector market consolidation.
thread: 2026-11-13: Manipal Health Enterprises Ltd completed acquisition of Kinder Women’s Hospital (Rs 130 cr) and integrated Sahyadri Hospitals (Rs 375 cr Q2 revenue).
2026-11-19: Park Medi World Ltd concall reiterated adding 1,430 beds in FY27 (4,290 current total capacity) on track to hit 6,590 beds by Dec 2028.
2026-11-26: Park Medi World Ltd completed acquisition of Mehar Mediserve LLP to deepen regional healthcare presence.
2026-11-28.cooking: Major hospital operators are aggressively acquiring regional healthcare assets and expanding organic bed counts to capture rising medical demand. High acuteness mix and post-integration synergy gains will drive average revenue per occupied bed (ARPOB) and operating leverage.
2026-11-28.confirm: Integration progress and ARPOB trajectory in Q3 FY27 operational results.
2026-11-28.risk: Initial margin drag from newly commissioned hospital beds and elevated receivable days from government health schemes.
2026-11-28.stage: building - M&A deals closed and bed expansions underway, while operational efficiencies and bed monetization will show across FY27-28.
